statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ),
  0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ), (2 * ↑π * I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1) = iteratedDeriv n f c / ↑n !

goal.text: (2 * ↑π * I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1) = iteratedDeriv n f c / ↑n !

atoms: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)
